analysis.title: Trane Technologies Plc (TT): 3Q26 First Take: Inline 3Q, continued order growth, guidance reaffirmed
key_insights: TT posted 3Q26 adj. EPS of $4.86 reported vs GS est $4.75 and FactSet consensus $4.73. Total segment EBIT was $1,454mn, -1% vs GS and inline (0%) vs consensus $1,452mn.

Americas segment EBIT beat (GS $1,232mn est, actual $1,258mn, +2%), offset by EMEA EBIT $130mn vs GS $154mn (-16%) and Asia Pacific EBIT $66mn vs GS $76mn (-13%). EMEA margin was 17.1% vs 20.4% GS est, APAC margin was 18.6% vs 22.7% GS est.
Total revenue was $6,760mn vs GS $6,483mn (+4%) and FactSet consensus $6,505mn (+4%). 3Q organic growth was +16% vs GS +10.7%.
Organic bookings were +20% in 3Q26 vs +37% in 2Q, driving a backlog of $12.5bn.
Americas Resi HVAC revenues were +20% (vs +low-teens in 2Q) and bookings +20% (vs +high-20s in 2Q).
Americas Commercial HVAC (CHVAC) revenues were +low-20s (vs +low-teens in 2Q) while bookings were +low-double-digits (vs +50% in 2Q). Global Applied orders were +40%.
EMEA organic revenues/bookings were +2%/+41%, with Commercial HVAC bookings up more than 60%. APAC organic revenues/bookings were +7%/+21%, with China revenues -high-single-digits and bookings -40%.
TT raised FY26 organic sales growth guidance to +11% from +9% (GS +9.4%) and reported growth to +13.5% from 11.5%. FY26 EPS guidance was reaffirmed at $15.20-$15.30 vs GS $15.40 and consensus $15.29.
4Q26 EPS guidance is ~$3.40-$3.50 vs consensus $3.62. GS expects the shares to underperform on the day given the inline segment result and the below-consensus 4Q guide.
GS rates TT Buy with a 12-month price target of $565 (21.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA estimates), 26.0% upside from the $448.47 close on 28 Oct 2026.

market_movers.rationale: Buy and $565 target are unchanged (target set 14-Oct-26). GS expects the shares to underperform on the day because 4Q26 EPS guidance of ~$3.40-$3.50 is below the $3.62 consensus.
